additional_anchor_review.reason: Section 13, line 241, prohibits the stated military/WMD-related and legally prohibited uses and restricts provision of controlled items to prohibited destinations or persons absent required permission.
Section 14.1.1, line 244, requires true, effective contact details, updates when they change, and reachable contact methods; it additionally addresses non-natural-person account administrators.
Section 14.1.4, line 247, separately requires contact details to be accurate and effective and updated in real time.
Section 14.2.3, line 251, requires the affected party to mitigate, resume performance as feasible, notify the other party immediately, and provide evidence and an explanation within 15 days.

Section 14.2.4, line 252, requires consultation after at least 60 days of force-majeure-related inability to perform; either party may terminate by notice if no continued-performance conditions are agreed within 30 days after consultation begins.

Section 14.4.2, line 259, allows the customer who disagrees to stop using the services, notify Alibaba Cloud to terminate, and migrate business data; continued use constitutes acceptance of the change.

Section 14.4.4, line 261, bars the customer from transferring or otherwise assigning the agreement to a third party without prior written consent. Sublicense is acknowledged in the anchor only as the closest available activity mapping, not as an actual sublicensing grant.

Section 14.4.10, line 267, authorizes Alibaba Cloud to use the customer’s name, marks, and project as a success case in the specified contexts, subject to the intellectual-property and confidentiality terms.
Section 14.4.11, line 268, contains both parties’ anti-bribery and anti-corruption commitment, including the stated covered personnel and agreement-related conduct.
